caption: The worked OR example, one epoch per row: weights are printed after each full pass over the examples in the fixed order (0,0), (0,1), (1,0), (1,1). The last row is the pass with zero mistakes, so training stops at w = (1, 1), b = 0 and the boundary sends (0,0) to class 0 and the other three points to class 1.

spec.title: OR example: weights after each epoch (order fixed)
spec.aria: A five-row table of the OR worked example: a header row naming the two weights, the bias and the mistake count, then epochs 1 to 4 giving w1, w2, b and mistakes as 0 1 1 1; 1 1 1 2; 1 1 0 1; and 1 1 0 0, with the last row marked as the zero-mistake pass where training stops.
